1. (Currently Amended) A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, __wherein the first sensor is in direct contact with the first battery cell or positioned in a gap between the first battery cell and the enclosure such that the first sensor responds to deformation of the first battery cell__.

2. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising an adhesive layer positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect mechanical stress on the first battery cell transmitted through the adhesive layer or through direct contact with the first battery cell__.

3. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the first sensor maintains sensitivity to forces applied to the first battery cell__.

4. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 3, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

5. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

6. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the enclosure.

7. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a deformable element positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the deformable element is configured to transmit mechanical forces from the first battery cell to the first sensor__.

8. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises an enclosure portion of protective film; and the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the enclosure portion, __wherein the protective film is configured to allow force transmission to the first sensor__.

9. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 8, wherein the protective film is a polyester film, __and wherein the polyester film has a thickness and material composition that permits detection of forces on the first battery cell by the first sensor__.

10. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises a plastic case portion; and the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the plastic case portion, __wherein the plastic case portion is configured to allow force transmission to the first sensor__.

11. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces resulting from compression or deformation between the first battery cell and the second battery cell__.

12. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising an adhesive layer between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __wherein the adhesive layer is configured to transmit mechanical forces between the first battery cell and the second battery cell to the first sensor__.

13. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor maintains sensitivity to forces applied to the first battery cell__.

14. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 13, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

15. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

16. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

17. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, __wherein the first sensor and the second sensor are each independently configured to detect mechanical stress or deformation of their respective battery cells__.

18. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 17 further comprising a processor configured to: receive a first sensor output signal from the first sensor indicating a force condition of the first battery cell; receive a second sensor output signal from the second sensor indicating a force condition of the third battery cell; conduct an evaluation based at least on the received output signals to determine whether mechanical stress or deformation has occurred in either the first battery cell or the third battery cell; and generate at least one processor output signal based on the evaluation.

19. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to alter an operation of the third battery cell independently from an operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the alteration is responsive to detection of mechanical stress or deformation in the third battery cell as indicated by the second sensor output signal__.

20. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to turn off the third battery cell and to maintain operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the decision to turn off the third battery cell is based on detection of mechanical stress or deformation in the third battery cell as indicated by the second sensor output signal__.

21. (Currently Amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material, __and wherein the force sensing material comprises a quantum tunneling composite__.

28. (Original) A method for monitoring a battery comprising a first cell and a second cell stacked within an enclosure, the method comprising: positioning a first sensor material between the first cell and one of the second cell and the enclosure; varying the conductance of the first material based on at least one force influencing the first cell; and producing a first force output signal based on the conductance of the first material.

29. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising controlling a facility of the first cell based on the force output signal.

30. (Original) The method of claim 28 further comprising: receiving a battery status signal, wherein the battery status signal is responsive to at least one of a voltage, a current, and a temperature of the first cell; evaluating the first force output signal and the battery status signal; and generating at least one evaluated output signal based on the evaluation of the first force output signal and the battery status signal.
